name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Oaths & Ashes
source:
Beneath the city's surface, clashing vampire factions have carved Berlin into a chessboard of blood and influence. The balance of power needs to be disrupted, if the old order enforced by the Ivory Tower is to prevail.

Sent by her Camarilla masters, the vampire Alice must navigate the intricacies of the politics at play to destabilise the region and sow discord, ensuring no one faction claims dominion. She encounters the Thinblood vampire Lenz, who is scraping by on the fringes of the undead society, using Alchemy in place of Alice's superior Disciplines. Now, they must choose: cooperate or betray one another to survive the perilous nights ahead.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4191110/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Oaths__Ashes/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在城市的表面之下，吸血鬼派系的冲突将柏林雕刻成一个充满血腥和影响力的棋盘。如果象牙塔所执行的旧秩序想要占上风，就需要打破权力平衡。

吸血鬼爱丽丝被她的卡玛利拉主人派来，必须应对错综复杂的政治局势，破坏该地区的稳定并煽动不和，确保没有任何派系声称拥有统治权。她遇到了薄血吸血鬼伦兹，他在不死社会的边缘挣扎，使用炼金术代替了爱丽丝的高级学科。现在，他们必须做出选择：合作或背叛彼此，以度过未来危险的夜晚。

[编辑自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4191110/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Oaths__Ashes/]Steam[/url]]
